name: NASA MERRA-2 Modern-Era Retrospective Analysis for Research and Applications
description: MERRA-2 (Modern-Era Retrospective analysis for Research and Applications, Version 2) is NASA's atmospheric reanalysis of the modern satellite era produced by the Global Modeling and Assimilation Office (GMAO). Spanning from 1980 to the present at 0.5° latitude by 0.625° longitude resolution with 72 hybrid-eta vertical levels, MERRA-2 incorporates hyperspectral radiance assimilation and is the first long-term global reanalysis to assimilate interactive aerosol observations (MODIS, MISR, AVHRR, AERONET). It provides continuous gridded estimates of radiation, precipitation, ozone, aerosols, and general atmospheric dynamics.
